findings.text: alert() opens the fleet alerts log and logs the message, which duplicates the same append already inlined in announce_requeue at fleet_supervisor.py:585; two writers of one alerts log should be one, so fold announce_requeue onto alert().

write_service_pid is given recorded_service_lock_inode(...) or _lock_inode(...), so a restart prefers the previous copy's recorded inode over the lock file's current one; where the lock file was deleted and recreated the pair written is (new pid, stale inode), which is the confusion the inode record exists to remove. Prefer the live lock file and fall back to the record.
